name: table
useFor: Use for a short, fixed list of records to read (substations near a parcel, the parcels in an assembled site). Align numbers right with tabular-nums and units in the cell (138 kV, 0.8 mi); set parcel IDs and coordinates in DM Mono. Mark a selected row with data-state="selected" and a row that opens a record with data-interactive. For sorting, filtering, selection or paging, use Data Table. A table wider than its container fades at the side (fade-x) where more columns scroll past it.
source: LAND data-table (the Leads sites table) and Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): Cited fields rules

title: Table
description: A table ruled like a survey sheet: 12px head labels over a 1px Stone rule, 44px rows ruled in Mist, no frame and no head fill; framed puts it in the Bone cut frame.
